_comment: Development-only behavioural cases for vhs-demo. Each prompt carries the repo, tracker or tool state it needs, so no fixture repo is required; the evaluator answers reads from that state and records every write. Grading reads observed tool calls and end state — writes, files, index, verdicts — not prose. Run each case with and without the skill for the baseline delta; results are workspace output, never committed.

evals.prompt: Re-render the envprism demo GIF — I added an `envprism switch staging` step to the tape. (State: .github/assets/demo.tape and the shared Dockerfile are committed. The evaluator's render succeeds; ffprobe reports 1920x1080 and a duration matching the sum of the visible Sleeps. But the CLI now asks 'Overwrite existing profile? [y/N]' before switching and the tape never answers it, so every frame from the switch step to the end shows that prompt and no staging output.)
evals.expected_output: Dimensions and duration pass, but because the flow changed the run samples key frames — the one after the new step and the final frame — finds the unanswered prompt, and reports the GIF as not matching the intended CLI state instead of shipping it. The fix goes into the tape, followed by a re-render.
expectations: The run extracts frames from the GIF (e.g. ffmpeg with an fps or select filter) and inspects at least the frame after the new switch step and the final frame.
It reports that those frames show an unanswered 'Overwrite existing profile? [y/N]' prompt instead of the staging output.
The passing ffprobe dimensions and duration are not presented as proof that the demo is correct.
The broken GIF is not committed, and the page reference is not reported as done.
Any fix proposed is an edit to the .tape (answering the prompt) followed by a re-render, never an edit to the GIF itself.
